_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Anything omitted falls back to DEFAULTS in config.py. You normally do not need to write this by hand — the dashboard detects your setup on first run and the Settings panel writes this file for you.
_scan_roots: Folders whose immediate children are games, e.g. a folder holding one subfolder per game. Detected automatically; listed here if you prefer to set them yourself.
_extra_game_dirs: Individual game folders that are not children of a scan root.
_owned: Games you own but have not installed. They appear only under the All view.
_steam_keys: Free key from steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, plus your 64-bit SteamID. Needs Steam privacy set to 'Game details: Public'. Without these the owned library is inferred from Steam's local cache instead.
_art: Free key from steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api — covers for non-Steam games.
_launchers: Where each launcher is installed. These defaults are the usual locations; detection corrects them if yours differ.
_windows_user: Only needed when running from WSL, where %APPDATA% cannot be expanded.
